state.description: The unstructured input text the model works over.

fields.description: Map of field name to field definition.

additionalProperties.description: One Clairic field definition: {type, instructions?, decimals?, integer?, unit?, items?, min?/max? (required for estimate), horizon? (forecast, 1-30), interval?, step?, scale?}.

images.description: Optional images array (max 4), passed through to the upstream.

tools.name: ai_decide

Every question requires an instructions string. Proxies POST ai.musebook.trade/v1/decide. Stateless inference call.

state.description: The unstructured input text the model works over.

questions.description: Map of question name to question definition.

additionalProperties.description: One Clef question: {type, instructions (REQUIRED), criteria?}. choice: criteria is an object mapping 2-10 option names to descriptions. noul: no criteria, answers a 0..1 probability. score: criteria is a LIST of 2-10 scale labels.

instructions.description: What is being asked. Required on every question.

criteria.description: choice: object mapping option names to descriptions. score: list of scale label strings. noul: omit.
